content: Godot high-level RPC requires matching node paths and signatures, with explicit authority/local-call/transfer policies. MultiplayerSynchronizer does not support Object/Resource properties or peer-specific instance IDs/RIDs. Project inference: transport synchronization cannot replace stable domain IDs, host transactions, coherent snapshot revisions, and idempotent commands. Sources: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/networking/high_level_multiplayer.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_multiplayersynchronizer.html
